description:
They called me their holy saintess, but they threw me into the abyss as a sacrifice 💔
I expected death, yet an ancient abyss god caught me.
The church’s “holy light” is nothing but a bloodthirsty parasite that feeds on believers’ faith.
When my dark god burned to ash to save me, I buried my old self.
I became the dark goddess, marching back to the holy mountain to burn all their lies to the ground.
Will we destroy the false god and survive the coming cosmic horror?
